title: Time Needed to Buy Tickets
summary: Given an array of ticket counts for each person in a line, determine the time taken for the person at position k to finish buying tickets.
statement: Given an array of ticket counts for each person in a line, determine the time taken for the person at position k to finish buying tickets. Each person buys one ticket per second and then re-enters the line to buy more tickets if they still need to buy more. If a person has no tickets left to buy, they leave the line.
constraints: tickets is nonempty with positive counts and k is a valid zero-based position.
Each second the front person buys one ticket; unfinished people rejoin the back.
Return the seconds elapsed when person k buys their last ticket.
hints: Count each person’s purchases before the target finishes instead of simulating the queue.
People at or before k buy at most tickets[k]; people after k buy at most tickets[k]-1.
Sum min(tickets[i],target) for i<=k and min(tickets[i],target-1) afterward.
Those caps exactly describe the complete queue rounds and the partial final round ending at k.
editorial: Those caps exactly describe the complete queue rounds and the partial final round ending at k.

tests.explanation: Each person buys twice before person two finishes, taking six seconds.
The three people behind the target buy at most four tickets each, so the target finishes after eight seconds.
